project.name: QH :: Module :: Party
project.description: BIAN-style Party subsystem: PARTY (abstract root, JOINED inheritance) with PERSON and ORGANIZATION subtypes, plus addresses, contact points, identifiers, names, roles, group/UBO memberships, signature specimens and compliance inquiries. Intentionally independent of the product-builder modules (core/commonrules/deposit/loan) - it only depends on qh-common, matching the project's SOA-style module independence. Every table lives in its own PARTY database schema and every tenant-scoped entity is isolated per institution via Hibernate's @TenantId discriminator-based multi-tenancy (see ir.bank.qh.common.tenant in qh-common).
